rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2-3 and Table 2, Figs 5-18: authors build and deploy their own ESP32/ThingsBoard IoT irrigation system in a test area in Fez, Morocco, reporting their own sensor readings (temperature, humidity, moisture, water level) and dashboard/e-mail notification outputs.
rows.notes: The study demonstrates that the system provides remote monitoring (ThingsBoard dashboards, data export) and e-mail alerts to farm owners, i.e. the remote monitoring/control capability that is a precondition of the claimed effect. It does not measure or survey farmer stress, workload, wellbeing or any related outcome; benefits to farmers are only asserted. Results are limited to a short series of sensor readings (Table 2, ~1 minute on 2023-11-28) and screenshots of dashboards and notifications; no pump-activation or irrigation outcome data are reported either. Hence no own evidence on the claimed effect.

notes: Full text appears complete. The paper is a system-design/proof-of-concept paper; its 'results' are dashboard visualisations of a few minutes of sensor telemetry plus e-mail notification screenshots, with no agronomic, water-saving or social outcome measured.
